decision: Treat r2 as a measured C1 KV-capacity rejection at gpu_memory_utilization=0.96. It proves neither long-context quality nor eight-image request allocation, and it does not justify CPU offload.
next_escalation: A bounded r3 retry may adjust only the GPU utilization envelope while retaining 327680, TP=2, GPU-resident PLE, and no CPU offload. It must capture resolved binding, KV admission, and a separate eight-image allocation probe.

pilot_oracle.capture_qualification: swift-r2-startup-all.txt retains combined stdout and stderr for the measured startup failure.
